Title: Generally available: Basic tier updates for Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Hyperscale (Citus)

Body.Content:
Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Hyperscale (Citus) Basic tier now supports new compute (16, 32, and 64 vCores in addition to previously supported 2, 4, and 8 vCores) and storage (1 TiB and 2 TiB options with 8 vCore or greater compute) options. 

The new compute and storage options are available for newly created Basic tier instances as well as on all existing Basic tier instances. With the 64 vCore compute now available, Basic tier nodes can get as much as 256 GiB RAM.

Learn more.
